rationale: Stage13 is the source-correctness firewall before GSA. Stage14 can faithfully approximate a wrong Stage12 zero-surface and therefore cannot repair source-shape error.
The superseded v1 policy was calibrated at 512x512 and incorrectly preregistered systematic one-pixel global erosion and dilation as ACCEPT controls.
The v2 calibration is native 1024x1024 and accepts only sparse isolated raster-boundary disagreement while rejecting systematic one-pixel silhouette bias and visible interior/component loss.
The exact 256-cube IRIS marching-cubes decoder followed by the exact 1024 Runtime-v3 rasterizer passes P999 on analytic sphere and ellipsoid controls, so P999 is above the measured numerical floor.
mutation_rule: After any new Knight Stage13 result is inspected, this policy may only be tightened prospectively; it may never be relaxed to convert a failure into PASS.
claim_boundary: This policy does not claim Knight compliance, Stage13 PASS, Stage15 PASS, QualifiedMesh PASS, or PRODUCT_PASS.
